preconditions.description: The input is a string containing the full standard input text.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) >= 1 and lines[0].strip().isdigit() if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) else False
preconditions.description: The first line of input contains a single integer T representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line.strip()), int) for line in lines[::2] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Every odd-indexed line (0-based) in the parsed input represents a valid integer N for a test case.

preconditions.expression: all(len(goals) == n for n, goals in zip([int(lines[i].strip()) for i in range(1, len(lines), 2)], [[int(x) for x in lines[i+1].split()] for i in range(1, len(lines), 2)]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of goal integers provided matches the specified N.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= g <= 1000000 for n in [int(lines[i].strip()) for i in range(1, len(lines), 2)] for g in [int(x) for x in lines[i+1].split()])
preconditions.description: All goal counts are non-negative integers within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == 'UNFIT' and max_diff == -1) or (output_lines[i] == str(max_diff) and max_diff > 0) for i, max_diff in enumerate([max((g_j - g_i) for i, g_i in enumerate(goals) for j, g_j in enumerate(goals) if j > i and g_j > g_i) if any(g_j > g_i for i, g_i in enumerate(goals) for j, g_j in enumerate(goals) if j > i) else -1 for goals in [[int(x) for x in lines[i+1].split()] for i in range(1, len(lines), 2)]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if there exists a pair of matches (i, j) with i < j and goals[j] > goals[i], the output is the maximum difference (goals[j] - goals[i]); otherwise, the output is 'UNFIT'.
